modos.descricao: Personal Totem - desafios nao podem ser recusados

passivas.descricao: Desafios desta criatura nao podem ser recusados

restricoes.descricao: So pode ter 1 personal totem por vez. Personagens com personal totem nao se beneficiam de pack totem.

_metadata.texto_original: Kirijama is a totem of cunning. He grants his children the Gift of stealth. This character's challenges cannot be refused. A character can only have 1 personal totem at a time. Characters with personal totems may no longer benefit from a pack totem.
